business.name: Honest Mobile Mechanics
business.description: Driveway, office lot, or the shoulder where it quit — we bring the shop to the vehicle. You get told what's wrong and what it costs before a wrench moves.

services.name: Mobile diagnostics
services.detail: We drive out, scan the vehicle and tell you what's actually wrong before any work is approved.

services.name: Brake service
services.detail: Pads, rotors, calipers and fluid. Done in your driveway or your work lot.

services.name: Battery, starter & alternator
services.detail: No-start diagnosis and replacement on site. The most common reason people call us.

services.name: Oil changes & maintenance
services.detail: Conventional through full synthetic, filters and fluids, on your schedule not a shop's.

services.name: Engine replacement
services.detail: Full engine replacement, handled end to end.

services.name: Transmission replacement
services.detail: Transmission removal and replacement on most makes.

services.name: Suspension & steering
services.detail: Struts, shocks, control arms, tie rods and wheel bearings.

services.name: Cooling system
services.detail: Radiators, water pumps, thermostats and hoses before an overheat becomes an engine.

services.name: Electrical & sensors
services.detail: Check-engine diagnosis, wiring faults, sensors and drivability troubleshooting.

services.name: Belts, hoses & pulleys
services.detail: Serpentine belts, timing components, tensioners and hose replacement.

services.name: Pre-purchase inspection
services.detail: Buying used? We meet you at the seller and inspect it before money changes hands. A shop can't do this.

services.name: State inspection runs
services.detail: We repair whatever failed, then take the vehicle in for its Texas inspection and bring it back. You never leave the house.

services.name: Tire service
services.detail: Flats and rotations on site. For a full set we collect the vehicle, get them mounted and balanced, and return it.

process.title: Tell us what it's doing
process.detail: Describe the noise, the light, the way it drives. We'll tell you what it likely is and what it'll run before anyone gets in a truck.

process.title: We drive out
process.detail: Home, work, or the shoulder of the highway at 2am. No tow bill, no rental car, no morning spent in a waiting room.

process.title: Fixed where it sits
process.detail: Most jobs finish in one visit. If it needs an inspection or a set of tires, we take it in and bring it back.

trustPoints.title: You never lose a day
trustPoints.detail: No drop-off, no shuttle ride, no arranging a pickup. The work happens where the car already is.

trustPoints.title: We do the running
trustPoints.detail: Inspections and tire fitting still need a facility. We take the vehicle, handle it, and return it.

trustPoints.title: The price comes first
trustPoints.detail: You approve a number before work starts. Nothing gets added without a phone call.

trustPoints.title: Any hour, any day
trustPoints.detail: A dead battery at midnight is still a dead battery. We answer at midnight.

trustPoints.title: You talk to the mechanic
trustPoints.detail: No service advisor in the middle translating. The person quoting is the person turning the wrench.

trustPoints.title: Sixty-one people, five stars
trustPoints.detail: A perfect rating across every customer who's left one. That's the whole record, not a highlight reel.

coverage.summary: Most shops make you come to them, then keep your car for three days. We work the whole metroplex — the close-in suburbs and the small towns on the edge that nobody else wants to drive to.
coverage.note: These are where we run most weeks, not a fence line. Give us your address and we'll tell you straight whether we can reach you.

cta.title: Sitting somewhere it shouldn't be?
cta.body: Tell us where it is and what it's doing. We'll tell you what it needs and what it costs — then drive out.

headings.services: Everything a shop does, minus the shop
